papers.title: Dual-Instrument Agreement
papers.current_ceiling: The agreement-nonidentifiability theorem is proved; a two-instance replacement case series is prospectively frozen and has no outcomes.
post_matrix_updates: Submission-package/PDF work may proceed additively, but it does not mature the temporal evidence.
load_bearing_adverse: The frozen instances directory is empty; QG-19 and QG-20 have no scientific outcomes.
n_valid=3 including Benchmark V0 does not authorize reliability, calibration, kappa or generalization.
Agreement alone is formally non-identifying and cannot establish instrument correctness.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The current two-instance case series is too small for a reliability claim, while its prospectivity would be destroyed by peeking, denominator reduction or retrospective replacement.
papers.decisive_question: When the already frozen QG-19 and QG-20 outcomes mature, what relation do the two instruments exhibit under the predeclared AGREE/PARTIAL/DISAGREE/CANNOT_CHECK semantics?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Only a bounded prospective case-series statement about the two named instances, interpreted through the nonidentifiability theorem.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: No reliability theorem is targeted by the current study; the valid result is the exact predeclared relation on each matured instance, with CANNOT_CHECK retained.
papers.population_or_universe: Exactly the two frozen replacement instances under Q3_REPLACEMENT_PROSPECTIVE_PROTOCOL_V2; a separate future registry of at least 20 items requires a new identity.
papers.unit_of_analysis: One frozen instance and the pair of independently generated instrument outputs.
historical_only_inputs: Benchmark V0 and all accessed development cases
design: Preserve the current frozen protocol and wait for naturally available outcomes.
Run each instrument using only the allowed base and protocol inputs.
Apply the frozen relation function with no denominator change.
For a later study, register at least 20 externally sourced cases before any outcomes and separate calibration from agreement.
baselines: Random-agreement reference for a later registry only.
primary_endpoints: Per-instance relation: AGREE, PARTIAL, DISAGREE or CANNOT_CHECK.
For the future registry only: accuracy against external gold, calibration and disagreement resolution.
negative_controls: One instrument silently reading the other output.
Missing outcome/gold, which must remain CANNOT_CHECK.
analysis_plan: Current study is descriptive/exact for two named cases; no inferential reliability statistic.
A later registry must freeze sample size, gold authority and interval method before outcomes.
Agreement is never interpreted as correctness without external gold.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Current identity has exactly two prospectively frozen cases and must not be enlarged or reduced. A later reliability study requires a separate at-least-20-case power plan.
papers.success_gate: The two outcomes mature naturally, both instruments execute under custody, and the exact frozen relation is reported without a reliability generalization.
papers.refutation_gate: DISAGREE, PARTIAL or CANNOT_CHECK are valid terminals and do not trigger replacement or rescue.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if an outcome does not exist, independence is violated or either instrument cannot execute exactly as frozen.
papers.authority_required: Current relation can be mechanically checked; any future correctness/reliability claim requires external gold or independent domain adjudication.
freeze_before_outcome: Nothing new for the current identity; its protocol is already frozen
For a future registry: cases, gold, instruments, relation, power, stopping rule
Outcome-availability and independence checks remain exactly as already frozen

active_lane.collision_rule: No parallel work may inspect, replace, accelerate or re-freeze QG-19/QG-20.

immediate_safe_actions: Add an aliasing note explaining the legacy ORION-03 identifiers without editing frozen files.
Prepare publication prose that states the two-case ceiling and the nonidentifiability theorem.
Design a separate future registry only from outcomes-disjoint cases.
forbidden_actions: Do not peek or accelerate outcomes.
Do not replace missing cases or reduce the denominator.
Do not report kappa, reliability or calibration from n_valid=3.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier temporal-measurement paper ultimately needs a larger prospectively registered corpus, external gold and calibration; the present frozen study must remain narrow and untouched.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns instrument agreement/nonidentifiability, not general authority (ORION-18) or research governance (ORION-24).
